title: Real public-file trial: metadata and reuse check of a NASA image

sources.title: Great Observatories' Unique Views of the Milky Way (PIA12348), NASA/JPL Photojournal

sources.role: NASA web-size version of the same image

licence: NASA media usage guidelines (https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/): content generally not subject to copyright in the US for educational or informational use. The image itself is not redistributed in this package; only metadata and hashes.

trials.note: Only one EXIF tag, DateTimeDigitized 2009:11:10 17:55:16. No original capture time and no camera or GPS tags. This is typical of a processed or published image; it is not a sign of anything else.

trials.input: NASA's own web-size version + a copy we resized to 1/8 and recompressed (pia_small_ourcopy.jpg, our edit, not from NASA)

output.note: التشابه الإدراكي يعني أن الصور متقاربة بصريًا وليس أنها من الحدث نفسه أو من المصدر نفسه. عتبة 8 من 64 بت للتجربة.

trials.note: Both land in one group at distance 0: the same picture at different sizes. Perceptual similarity does not show where an image came from.

limits: imghash refuses images over 25 million pixels (a memory safety cap); the 47-megapixel original was therefore not hashed. exif reads bytes only and works on it.
browser_check: Same inputs run in the browser build through the file picker (headless Chrome, localhost): same results, no external requests.
